title: Silk Gallery
shortDescription: Pale galleries of silk keep the old stone polite.
longDescription:
The stair opens into a long gallery that the Collegium maps do not name. Silk is stretched from pillar to pillar like sheets put out to dry. Lantern-light from far above reaches here only as a rumour.
Piper Mole sits on a crate that has forgotten its cargo, listening with both ears and one paw on the silk.

fixtures.name: Piper Mole
fixtures.lookDescription: A small mole in a patched grey coat, a tin whistle at the belt, silk dust on both paws. Try talk piper.
fixtures.examineDescription: Piper's eyes are used to dark. The whistle is dented. The coat has been mended with the same care as a score. He listens before he speaks, and he does not pretend the silk is decoration.
fixtures.dialogue: "I keep this stair because the silk has begun to sing. Alder sent you, or the wood did. Examine the threads. The cloister and the nave wait east. Do not wake more than you can name."

welcome.text: "I am Piper. I keep the stair below the empty frame. The silk has begun to sing, and a hatchling woke before its queen. Talk if you will. Examine the threads. East is the cloister. South of that, the nave."

woke.text: "A silk-hatchling. Small, hungry, and earlier than the score allows. It is a lesson, not a throne. If it squares up, treat it as Flint treats a dummy: finish the work, then walk away."

queen.text: "Not yet. Alder will not send one Collegian for that. Learn the rooms. Name what you see. Then go back up and talk alder. Three will be needed later."

fixtures.name: Silk Thread
fixtures.examineDescription: The thread is warm. It holds a note the way a string holds a bow. Pressed lightly, it answers with the same three pulses that rise through the Clock Tower oak. This is a cradle, not a snare.
